references.text: Bezalel made the lampstand of a talent of pure gold, together with all its utensils, in fulfillment of the instructions given here.
The preceding verses describe the details of the lampstand that was to be made from the pure gold mentioned in verse 39.
Mentions the total amount of gold used in the sanctuary, including the talent used for the lampstand.
David gave gold for the lampstands in the temple, showing continuity in the use of gold for holy lampstands.
Solomon's temple had lampstands of pure gold, reflecting the standard set in the tabernacle.
John saw seven golden lampstands in his vision, linking back to the golden lampstand in the tabernacle.
The direct fulfillment of the instruction to use a talent of pure gold for the lampstand.
Highlights how the requirement for pure gold was realized in the uniform construction of the lampstand.
